summary:
Comprehensive architectural plan for Velorix Esports Admin:
1. Multi-Tournament Batch Management: Multi-slot scheduler, quick clone generator, and category-wide tournament creation.
2. Custom Prize Distribution Engine: Human-readable prize breakdowns, per-slot calculations, per-kill bounty notes, and on-the-fly dashboard adjustment.
3. Complete Emoji Removal & Esports Design Overhaul: Replacing all casual emojis with sleek Material Symbols, high-contrast badges, and pro esports typography.
4. Automated Authentication & Zero-Gate Access: Automatic session restoration from splash, seamless auto-login, and removal of manual KYC approval hurdles.
5. In-Depth Profile & Full Referral Tracking System: User profile drill-down displaying detailed player metrics and an itemized list of all referred users with earnings and activity status.
6. Unified Information Architecture: Clean, consolidated console consolidating previously fragmented screens into unified, intuitive hubs.
